newsitem.title: UK: Telewest yr losses yawn wider than forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Telewest yr losses yawn wider than forecasts.

text.p: NOTE - Analysts had forecast pre-tax losses in a range between 246 and 165.5 million stg.

Comparative turnover and pretax figures do not include the effect of the former SBC CableComms UK franchises, which Telewest bought on October 3, 1995. Including the franchises, 1995 pretax losses were 148.53 and 1995 turnover was 191.20 million stg, finance director Charles Burdick told Reuters.
Full company name - Telewest Communications Plc
A breakdown of revenue on a proforma basis follows:
Total revenue up 52 pct to 290.3 million stg
cable television revenue up 45 pct to 121.2 million stg
residential telephony revenue up 54 pct to 125 million stg
business telephony revenue up 68 pct to 34.6 million stg
Telewest reported that earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amorisation (EBITDA) broke into the black at 0.5 million stg in the year to December 31, 1996.
Capital expenditure in the year rose 31 percent to 515.6 million stg.
